participant_id.Description: De-identified participant identifier, matching the sub-NN folder names.

age.Description: Self-reported age in years. Questionnaire item: "What is your age?" (free numeric entry).

sex.Description: Self-reported. Questionnaire item: "What is your gender?" (free-text entry).

handedness.Description: Self-reported dominant hand. Questionnaire item: "Which is your dominant hand?"

stress.Description: Self-reported current stress at baseline. Questionnaire item: "How stressed do you currently feel?", answered on a 1-5 scale. Values 1-4 were used by this sample; no participant selected 5.

Levels.1: relaxed and not stressed at all

sleep_duration.Description: Self-reported sleep the previous night. Questionnaire item: "How much sleep did you get last night?", answered as a single selection from seven fixed options. Values are the option labels exactly as presented to participants; note that "0-2 hours", "3-5 hours" and "10+ hours" denote ranges, not point values, so this variable is ordinal rather than continuous.

Levels.10+ hours: 10 or more hours (not selected by this sample)

exercise_last_hour.Description: Questionnaire item: "Have you exercised vigorously in the last hour?"

alcohol_last_hour.Description: Questionnaire item: "Have you drunk alcohol in the last hour?"

caffeine_last_hour.Description: Questionnaire item: "Have you consumed any caffeinated beverages in the last hour?"

liking_jungle.Description: Liking rating for the jungle soundscape, given immediately after its exposure. Questionnaire item: "Overall, how would you rate the audio that you listened to?", answered on a 1-7 scale with only the endpoints labelled.

Levels.1: negative, did not like it at all

liking_deconstruct.Description: Liking rating for the deconstruct soundscape, given immediately after its exposure. Questionnaire item: "Overall, how would you rate the audio that you listened to?", answered on a 1-7 scale with only the endpoints labelled.

Levels.1: negative, did not like it at all
